title: Prepare and select native reference queries

gates.name: Python typecheck
gates.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps backend python -m mypy src/face_moment

gates.name: Reference query tests
gates.command: docker compose run --rm backend python -m pytest tests/processing/test_reference_query.py

verify.summary: Fresh independent T2 verification passed native SFace/Buffalo reference preparation, inspect-all deterministic at-most-five selection, quality rejection, revision/asset isolation, owner-boundary checks, focused tests, adapter regressions, mypy and Memory Bank lint. Executor evidence remained supporting-only; lifecycle remains in_progress.
Scheduler closed TASK-069 after independent T2 verification PASS and Judge-supported lifecycle review; no code, spec or scope changes were made at closure.

evidence_required: Realtime Search `Native reference-query operations` plus `Server-authoritative occurrence selection` RED: the processing FaceEngine seam supports Photo processing only and has no reference inspection/preparation or at-most-five selector; GREEN: both direct adapters inspect and prepare a crop only through their own admitted immutable revision, and the processing selector deterministically orders all occurrences by quality then occurrence_index, retains at most five and marks low-quality selections without tracking, clustering or deduplication; decisive comparison: ordered/tied/repeated-person/low-quality fixtures and native-call traces; artifact: focused pytest under .tasks/TASK-069-T2-FT-004-W1/.
purpose: Extend the existing processing-owned direct engines with the smallest native reference-query seam and deterministic server selection needed by realtime search.
success_outcome: Processing produces an ordered at-most-five selected-query observation set through the committed SFace or Buffalo M native path, with explicit quality gates and no cross-pipeline or identity-grouping behavior.
anti_goals: Do not query PostgreSQL/pgvector, compute candidate pools or publish Promo state.
Do not add an engine registry, generic adapter factory, fallback pipeline or client-side selection.
Do not add tracking, identity clustering, deduplication, embedding merge or top-1/top-2 margin.

forbidden_scope: Exact Photo search and pHash ranking owned by TASK-070-T2-FT-004-W2
Serving-setting mutation and model-asset download or fallback
stop_conditions: Native reference preparation cannot reuse the admitted direct adapters without another engine abstraction.
Selection requires person identity, tracking or cross-pipeline state.
The committed revision cannot remain immutable throughout one request.

constraints: Keep SFace YuNet/alignCrop and Buffalo M SCRFD/native-alignment preparation distinct.
Use the immutable RealtimeContext values supplied by the completed serving_control boundary without writing that owner state.
A selected unacceptable crop returns a bounded rejected observation; no gate weakening or alternate pipeline is allowed.
invariants: Every crop is inspected independently before deterministic at-most-five selection.
Repeated occurrences of one physical person remain valid and may occupy all selected slots.
Only the committed validated pre-warmed revision processes a request.
verification_targets: Separate SFace and Buffalo traces prove native preparation and revision/dimension/asset mismatch rejection.
Ordered, tied, repeated-person and low-quality fixtures prove deterministic selection and every forbidden grouping path.
